title: Split event bus dispatch, pipeline routing, and event logging boundaries
description: Rust EventBus is small today, but AstrBot routes events by config-specific PipelineScheduler and logs platform/session outlines inside the bus. Split dispatch, scheduler routing, event logging, and future backpressure policy before multiple pipeline configs and lifecycle events grow inside one core event module.

files.change: Keep EventBus/EventExecutor public exports stable while moving internals into focused modules.
Prepare a routing boundary for config/session-aware scheduler selection instead of hardwiring one executor.
Keep platform/session event logging outside scheduler and runtime handle code.

criteria: Current single-executor EventBus behavior remains unchanged.
Routing and logging can be tested independently from pipeline execution.
RuntimeHandle still supervises EventBus as a background task without knowing routing internals.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-core && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test --workspace
